4 of 5 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
Market Competitiveness Review — Online Education Sector

The committee considered the Market Competitiveness Review — Online Education Sector, a proposal to implement a new HRIS system. The project was approved with a total budget of $148M over 46 years.

Motion

To approve for mission: RESOLVED, that the Workplace Modernization Task Force recommends the appointment of Daviess Hartwell Partners as the company's independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ending 1992-01-21.

Moved: Elise Kulkarni  •  Seconded: Thomas Negash
Vote: 3 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  1 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 2
Workforce Analytics Platform Demo and Proposal

The committee considered the Workforce Analytics Platform Demo and Proposal, a proposal to divest the Online Education business unit. The committee authorized management to engage an investment bank to explore strategic alternatives.

Motion

To approve for implementation: RESOLVED, that the Workplace Modernization Task Force tables the motion regarding the Workforce Analytics Platform Demo and Proposal until such time as the requested supplementary data can be provided and reviewed.

Moved: Eddie Braun  •  Seconded: Thomas Negash
Vote: 4 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Total Rewards Benchmarking — Peer Group Refresh

The committee discussed the Total Rewards Benchmarking — Peer Group Refresh, a review of the company's compliance with environmental laws. The committee reviewed the company's environmental impact and confirmed that it was in compliance.

Motion

To amend: RESOLVED, that the Workplace Modernization Task Force shall enter into executive session to discuss confidential matters.

Moved: Elise Kulkarni  •  Seconded: Thomas Negash
Vote: 3 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  1 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 4
Records Management Policy Audit Findings

The committee discussed the Records Management Policy Audit Findings, a review of the company's compliance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The committee reviewed the company's periodic reports and confirmed that they were in compliance.

Item 5
Sustainability Report 1992 — Draft Review

The committee received an update on the Sustainability Report 1992 — Draft Review from Nikolai Hong. The project is currently on schedule and under budget. The next major milestone is 1992-03-28. No committee action was required.

Motion

To ratify as corrected: RESOLVED, that the Workplace Modernization Task Force defers consideration of the Sustainability Report 1992 — Draft Review to the next scheduled meeting, pending receipt of additional analysis from the responsible owner.

Moved: Elise Kulkarni  •  Seconded: Thomas Negash
Vote: 3 Yea  /  1 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
